company_info.name: Zomato
company_info.description: Zomato is an Indian multinational restaurant aggregator and food delivery company. It provides information, menus and user-reviews of restaurants as well as food delivery options from partner restaurants in select cities.

faq.question: What does Zomato do?
faq.answer: Zomato connects customers, restaurants, and delivery partners. We help customers discover restaurants, order food delivery, and make dining reservations. For restaurants, we provide a platform to reach more customers and manage orders.

faq.question: How can I list my restaurant on Zomato?
faq.answer: You can register your restaurant online via the 'Add your restaurant' link on our website. You'll need to provide basic details, FSSAI license, and PAN card information.

faq.question: Is there a fee to list my restaurant?
faq.answer: Currently, there are no upfront listing fees for registering your restaurant on Zomato in India.

faq.question: What are the commission charges?
faq.answer: Commission rates typically range from 15% to 30% per order, depending on factors like location, average order value, and whether you use Zomato's delivery fleet or your own.

faq.question: What is Zomato Gold?
faq.answer: Zomato Gold is a subscription program that offers members exclusive benefits like discounts on dining out and free delivery at partner restaurants.

faq.question: Do you offer advertising for restaurants?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer advertisement solutions to help restaurants improve their visibility on the platform through sponsored listings.

faq.question: How do I get paid for orders?
faq.answer: Payouts are processed weekly. The amount transferred is the order value minus the commission and other applicable charges.
